mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS turnover, d.date -- 建议同时返回日期，方便查看对应关系 FROM ( -- 递归生成从begin到end的所有日期 WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS date -- 起始日期 UNION ALL SELECT date + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_series WHERE date < #{end} -- 终止日期 ) SELECT date FROM date_series) d LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.order_time) = d.date AND o.status = 5 GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date;
# 统计order表，creat_time == time的订单数量，空返回0 SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(id), 0) FROM orders WHERE DATE(order_time) = #{time}
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(id), 0) FROM orders WHERE DATE(order_time) = #{time} AND status = 5

SELECT fd.name, SUM(fd.number) AS number FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_detail fd ON o.id = fd.order_id WHERE o.status = 5 AND DATE(order_time) BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY fd.name ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 0,10
